_README: Declared INTENT for the live pipeline. ops_assertions.py --check compares
the running system against this file and reports every disagreement.
This file is the source of truth: if reality is right and this is wrong,
change this file deliberately — do not let the two silently diverge,
which is the exact failure it exists to catch.

Portfolio Optimiser Daily._why: 10:20 is LOAD-BEARING (daily_auto.ps1 .NOTES, 2026-08-03): at 09:30 the run fires before the ASX opens, so --wait-for-funds expires and the largest buy defers every rebalance.

Portfolio Optimiser Evidence._why: Evening scale-sensitivity sweep; must run AFTER any morning execution.

Portfolio Optimiser US Session._why: 02:00 is the only clock time inside US RTH under all three AEST/AEDT x EDT/EST combinations, so it never needs seasonal adjustment. TUE-SAT because Monday's plan trades in the US session still open at 02:00 Tuesday, and Friday's at 02:00 Saturday.

exe._why: engine_sources are the files COMPILED INTO the binary. ibkr_paper_exec.py is deliberately absent: it runs from source, so editing it must not flag the exe as stale.
